blocks.text: All 50 recorded characteristics are shown; 46 were screening candidates. HE, PT, PTA and MELD-Na were descriptive rather than screening candidates. Core4 consists of INR, PLT, ALBI and FIB-4. All non-viral continuous fields retain their recorded numeric scale without an added transformation. Category meanings are retained rather than re-diagnosed. Measurement-time anchors and treatment timing are not assumed uniform.

blocks.text: B Fixed-development selection status
blocks.display_html: B Fixed-development selection status

blocks.text: Both methods received all 46 candidate source variables from the 312-patient development cohort; univariable P values did not filter inputs. Statuses refer to source variables, not separate design-matrix terms. Original Boruta: 9 confirmed, 1 tentative and 36 rejected. Albumin was tentative and retained after RoughFix. LASSO λ1se retained 5 variables; Boruta retained 10; their intersection was Core4.

Statuses refer to source variables, not separate design-matrix terms. Original Boruta: 9 confirmed, 1 tentative and 36 rejected. Albumin was tentative and retained after RoughFix. LASSO λ1se retained 5 variables; Boruta retained 10; their intersection was Core4.

blocks.text: B Full nested-selection frequencies
blocks.display_html: B Full nested-selection frequencies

blocks.text: All 100 outer-training selections completed. Frequencies use all 100 selections, irrespective of downstream fitting failures. Each outcome-stratified 70:30 partition used 312 outer-training and 133 outer-test patients from the 445-patient domestic cohort. Selection used LASSO λ1se and Boruta after TentativeRoughFix. Original Core4 membership was a reference label and did not constrain nested selection.
